title: Higurashi WHEN THEY CRY: Abducted by Demons Arc
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Keiichi Maebara moves to the rural village of Hinamizawa and enjoys games with his new school friends, until he learns of a grisly local murder tied to the village's demon-god Oyashiro-sama. He grows convinced his friends are plotting against him, and the arc ends unresolved, leaving readers to question whether he is victim or culprit.
life_message: Fear and secrecy can turn friends into enemies; trust, or its absence, decides what people become.

content.note: Murders, razor blades in rice cakes and mysterious injections (ANN review; AniList Gore, MU Murder/s).
Frequent sharp scare scenes are the arc's signature (ANN); AniList Horror, Psychological.
Escalating paranoia and possible delusion; AniList Memory Manipulation, Denpa; a farewell letter ends the arc (ANN).
Keiichi carries a bat everywhere out of fear (ANN); punishment-game pranks.
